title: Portable standard C++ federation-scoped handle decoding contract

portable_boundary.headers: official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTI API headers
portable_boundary.inputs: provider library, DDM FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation supplied by adapter

assertions: all decoders reject use before connect with NotConnected
all decoders reject use before join with FederateNotExecutionMember
actual federation-scoped handles round-trip through their matching decoder
a provider-created timestamped message-retraction handle round-trips
empty encodings are rejected with CouldNotDecode
evidence_scope: portable source boundary plus installed-package adapter, both standard callback models
notes: This slice proves public C++ decoder behavior and lifecycle boundaries; it does not claim cross-provider encoding interoperability or protected-review evidence.
